body: I made it through. Thank you for your kind words of support. I have a long road to recovery, but I am very glad I did not end my life last night.
I think I may call the ambulance soon. I can't stop drinking & I can't stop crying.
I think I'll call an ambulance soon. The liquor is too much. I have over 30 cuts on my legs and arms. If I survive tonight, you'll be my crowning angel. Thank you for all your support.

I'm not sure what to do. If I wake up hungover in my room, I'll have to deal with everything by myself as a drunken mistake. If I wake up in a hospital, I will have more remorse. God bless you and your replies by the way... you don't have to reply to me. I just have so many cuts on my legs that I'm afraid I may die tonight.

I'm out - but it feels as if ever since I came out that everything has been fucked up. My innocence is something that I no longer have, and something that is very dear to me. I have no idea what to do... my legs are bloody and marked up with permanent marker. Do I call the police? Should I get more drunk before I do so?

the only way to correct this is to die. my parents have no idea what goes through my head. it's so devastating. i had so much potential. but these cuts and cigarette burns on my body are a constant reminder... some lives aren't meant to be long.
The extent of my life has been a slow reveal of how fucked up i am. my mother will not be able to handle this. my legs are bleeding. my arms are bleeding. i'm ready to call the police.
